senses.definition: the flood storage, sediment trapping, nutrient filtering and carbon burial that wet ground performs
senses.definitionCN: 湿地进行蓄洪、拦沙、过滤养分与埋藏碳的功能
senses.example: The wetland held back the flood peak for six hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这片湿地把洪峰拦住了六个小时。
senses.why: policy began to value wetlands for what they do, not only for what they are.
senses.whyCN: 政策开始重视湿地「做什么」，而不只是「是什么」。

senses.title: A constructed wetland for treatment
senses.titleCN: 用于污水处理的工程湿地
senses.definition: an engineered bed of gravel, soil and reeds designed to clean wastewater as it passes through
senses.definitionCN: 由砾石、土壤与芦苇构成、使污水通过时得到净化的工程床
senses.example: The sewage works discharges into a constructed wetland before the river.
senses.exampleCN: 污水厂先把水排入人工湿地，再进入河流。
senses.why: the same word covers a built facility, because it reproduces the natural process on purpose.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也指人工设施，因为它有意复制自然过程。

senses.title: Wetland restoration and conservation
senses.definition: the return of drained or filled ground to wet conditions, often by blocking ditches and reintroducing water
senses.definitionCN: 把排干或填埋的地恢复为湿生状态，常靠堵沟与重新引水
senses.example: Blocking the drains restored the wetland within three years.
senses.exampleCN: 堵住排水沟后，湿地在三年内恢复。
senses.why: conservation turned the cover word into a target, since most wetlands were lost by drainage.
senses.whyCN: 保护工作把这个覆盖词变成目标，因为多数湿地是被排干而失去的。

senses.title: Coastal wetlands
senses.definition: salt marshes, mangroves and tidal flats where fresh and salt water meet and tides set the rhythm
senses.definitionCN: 咸淡水交汇、潮汐定节奏的盐沼、红树林与潮滩
senses.example: The coastal wetland buffers the village from storm surge.
senses.exampleCN: 这片滨海湿地为村庄缓冲风暴潮。
senses.why: tides replace rainfall as the water source, so the same cover word takes a marine setting.
senses.whyCN: 潮汐取代降水成为水源，因此同一个覆盖词进入海洋环境。

senses.title: Wetland delineation for regulation
senses.titleCN: 法规中的湿地边界划定
senses.definition: the field test of hydric soil, water saturation and hydrophytic plants that fixes a legal boundary
senses.definitionCN: 以水成土、水分饱和与湿生植物三项现场指标确定法律边界
senses.example: The delineation found wetland inside the proposed building plot.
senses.exampleCN: 边界划定在拟建地块内发现了湿地。
senses.why: regulation needs a line on the ground, so the three criteria turn a habitat into a jurisdiction.
senses.whyCN: 法规需要地面上的一条线，于是三项指标把一个生境变成管辖范围。

intro.en: Wetland is a native English compound of wet and land, both Germanic; it became a standard term only in the twentieth century.
intro.cn: wetland 是 wet 与 land 构成的英语本族复合词，两者都属日耳曼语；到 20 世纪才成为标准术语。

items.en: Wæt meant 'wet, moist'. Its Germanic stock is usually reconstructed as *wataz, of uncertain deeper origin.
items.cn: wæt 意为「湿的」。其日耳曼词干通常重构为 *wataz，更深来源不确定。

items.en: Land meant 'ground, territory', from Germanic *landam, itself of unsettled pre-Germanic origin.
items.cn: land 意为「土地、领土」，出自日耳曼语 *landam，其在日耳曼语之前的来源无定论。

items.en: Wet land appears as plain description in nineteenth-century writing on drainage and agriculture.
items.cn: wet land 在 19 世纪关于排水与农业的写作中作为平实描述出现。

items.en: Twentieth-century ecology and the 1971 Ramsar Convention fixed wetland as a single class covering marshes, bogs, fens and shallow water.
items.cn: 20 世纪生态学与 1971 年拉姆萨尔公约把 wetland 固定为涵盖沼泽、泥炭沼、矿质沼泽与浅水的单一类别。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and root): the earliest use of the closed compound is not securely dated, and the deeper roots of wet and land are reconstructions.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与词根）：这个闭合复合词的最早使用年代不可靠；wet 与 land 的更深词根均属重构。

note.en: Group one separates the parallel -land cover compounds; group two separates the wetland types that are often used interchangeably.
note.cn: 第一组区分并列的 -land 覆盖复合词；第二组区分常被混用的湿地类型。

entries.definition: Land covered by trees; the defining factor is woody cover, not water.
entries.definitionCN: 树木覆盖的土地；决定因子是木本覆盖，不是水。

entries.definition: Land dominated by grass; it is usually well drained, the opposite condition to wetland.
entries.definitionCN: 以草为主的土地；通常排水良好，与湿地条件相反。

entries.definition: Land that depends on rainfall alone, without irrigation; it is the direct counterpart of wetland in agriculture.
entries.definitionCN: 仅靠降水、不灌溉的土地；在农业语境中是湿地的直接对照。

entries.definition: Land used for farming; it is a land-use class and can include drained former wetland.
entries.definitionCN: 用于农业的土地；是土地利用类别，可包含排干后的旧湿地。

entries.definition: Wetland dominated by grasses and reeds in shallow water; one type within the wider class.
entries.definitionCN: 浅水中以草与芦苇为主的湿地；是更大类别中的一种。

entries.definition: Wetland dominated by trees or shrubs, often with standing water; the woody counterpart of marsh.
entries.definitionCN: 以乔木或灌木为主、常有积水的湿地；是沼泽的木质对应型。

entries.definition: Acid peatland fed only by rain, with mosses and very low nutrient supply.
entries.definitionCN: 仅靠雨水补给的酸性泥炭地，长苔藓，养分极低。

entries.definition: Peatland fed by mineral-rich groundwater, so it is less acid and more fertile than a bog.
entries.definitionCN: 由富含矿物的地下水补给的泥炭地，比泥炭沼酸性低、更肥沃。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: wet + land: ground that stays wet long enough to change its soil and plants.
normal.cn: wet + land：湿得够久、足以改变土壤与植物的地。

normal.en: The family runs wet, wetness, wetland, dryland.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 wet、wetness、wetland、dryland。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: constructed wetland, coastal wetland, wetland restoration, wetland delineation.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：人工湿地、滨海湿地、湿地恢复、湿地边界划定。

normal.en: Four main types: marsh, swamp, bog, fen.
normal.cn: 四个主要类型：marsh、swamp、bog、fen。

normal.en: The image is reeds in shallow water beside a town drain.
normal.cn: 意象是浅水中的芦苇，旁边是城镇排水口。

abstract.en: Think of a sponge that also serves as a filter and a nursery.
abstract.cn: 想象一块同时充当过滤器与育婴房的海绵。

abstract.en: Think of a boundary drawn not by a fence but by soil colour and plant roots.
abstract.cn: 想象一条不靠栅栏、而靠土色与植物根划出的边界。

abstract.en: Think of a place that is neither land nor water and is valuable for exactly that.
abstract.cn: 想象一个既非陆地也非水域的地方，而它的价值正来自这种中间性。

examples.en: Draining the wetland removed the village's natural flood defence.
examples.cn: 排干湿地使村庄失去了天然的防洪屏障。

examples.en: The constructed wetland removes nitrogen before the water reaches the lake.
examples.cn: 人工湿地在河水入湖前去除氮。

examples.en: Migrating cranes depend on a chain of shallow wetlands.
examples.cn: 迁徙的鹤依赖一连串浅水湿地。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「wet（湿）+ land（土地）」——长期湿着的土地 → 湿地

root: wet（古英语 wæt「湿的」，日耳曼语 *wataz 为重构）+ land（古英语 land「土地」，日耳曼语 *landam）。英语复合词，20 世纪成为科学与法律术语；无拉丁成分。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from wet ground itself to its legal definition, its types, its services, its built imitation, its restoration, its coastal form and its regulated boundary.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从湿的地本身，走向法律定义、类型、服务、人工仿制、恢复、滨海形式与受管制的边界。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: ground where water decides what soil and plants can be.
core.cn: 核心意象：由水决定土壤与植物能怎样的地面。

branches.en: DEFINITION: wet ground becomes a treaty category covering many habitat types.
branches.cn: 定义：湿的地变成涵盖多种生境的条约类别。

branches.en: TYPES: water source and chemistry separate marsh, swamp, bog and fen.
branches.cn: 类型：水源与化学区分沼泽、木本沼泽、泥炭沼与矿质沼泽。

branches.en: WORK: the wetland stores floods and filters water, and engineers copy the process.
branches.cn: 工作：湿地蓄洪滤水，工程师复制这一过程。

branches.en: REPAIR AND COAST: drained ground can be rewetted, and tides create a marine version.
branches.cn: 修复与海岸：排干的地可重新蓄水，潮汐造出海洋版本。

branches.en: JURISDICTION: soil, water and plants draw a legal line on the ground.
branches.cn: 管辖：土壤、水与植物在地面上画出法律界线。

intro.en: Wetland is a native two-word compound; its family is small and built from wet rather than from prefixes.
intro.cn: wetland 是本族两词复合；其词族很小，且由 wet 派生，而非靠前缀。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin element in wetland; both halves are Germanic, so the Latin list is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: wetland 没有拉丁成分；两半都属日耳曼语，因此拉丁词条留空。

items.example: The path stayed wet all winter.
items.exampleCN: 小路整个冬天都是湿的。

items.example: The land lies below the high tide line.
items.exampleCN: 这块地低于高潮线。

items.example: The wetland fills every spring.
items.exampleCN: 这片湿地每年春天蓄满水。

items.example: Wetness decides which plants can root here.
items.exampleCN: 潮湿程度决定哪些植物能在此扎根。

items.example: The wetted margin stays green in August.
items.exampleCN: 被水浸润的边缘在八月仍绿。

items.example: Wetting the peat restarts the moss.
items.exampleCN: 润湿泥炭能让苔藓复苏。

items.example: Wetland restoration blocked the old drains.
items.exampleCN: 湿地恢复堵住了旧排水沟。

items.meaning: land without irrigation or standing water
items.example: Dryland farming depends on stored soil moisture.
items.exampleCN: 旱地农业依赖土壤蓄水。

definition_zh: 保护主义；贸易保护主义；以关税和非关税手段庇护本国产业的主张
definition_en: the policy or doctrine of shielding domestic industries from foreign competition
core_image: 一道高墙围住本国的工厂，墙外货物排队等候，墙角写着按品类征税的价目
scene: 议会听证会上，一位议员主张给本国钢铁厂筑起关税高墙，以挡住海外低价货源。 The senator defended protectionism as a way to keep local mills open.
sceneCN: 这里指「以壁垒庇护本国产业的主张」，对应第 1 个义项：通过关税与非关税手段限制外国竞争的政策；句意为这位参议员为保护主义辩护，称它能让本地工厂维持开工。画面要点：听证席、高墙、工厂烟囱、关税价目牌。

pos.zh: 保护主义；贸易保护主义（不可数）

derivatives.zh: 保护（protect 加名词后缀，指被遮蔽的状态或措施）
保护主义者；保护主义的（protectionism 的施动与形容形式）
保护性的（protect 加形容词后缀，指具有遮蔽作用的）
保护者（protect 加施动后缀，指执行保护的人或物）
保护（源自拉丁 protegere「在前面遮盖」，语义为挡住侵害）

senses.title: Shielding domestic industry by policy
senses.definition: the policy of restricting imports so that domestic producers face less foreign competition
senses.definitionCN: 限制进口以使本国生产者面对更少外国竞争的政策
senses.example: The senator defended protectionism as a way to keep local mills open.
senses.exampleCN: 这位参议员为保护主义辩护，称它能让本地工厂维持开工。
senses.why: Protection is a covering placed in front, and the suffix -ism turns it into a doctrine, so the word is a policy of standing a shield before home industry.
senses.whyCN: protection 是挡在前面的遮蔽物，后缀 -ism 把它变成一种主张，因此这个词就是用盾牌挡在本国产业之前的政策。

senses.title: Protection by tariffs
senses.definition: the use of import duties to make foreign goods more expensive than domestic ones
senses.definitionCN: 用进口税使外国货比本国货更贵
senses.example: Tariff protectionism raised the price of imported cloth.
senses.exampleCN: 关税保护主义抬高了进口布料的价格。
senses.why: A duty is the simplest wall, so the tariff case became the classic form of the doctrine.
senses.whyCN: 关税是最简单的墙，因此关税情形成为这种主张的经典形式。

senses.title: Protection by non-tariff means
senses.titleCN: 以非关税手段实现的保护
senses.definition: the use of quotas, licensing, standards or inspections to limit imports without a tariff
senses.definitionCN: 用配额、许可、标准或检验在不加关税的情况下限制进口
senses.example: Licensing rules became a quieter form of protectionism.
senses.exampleCN: 许可规则成了一种更安静的保护主义。
senses.why: When tariffs are capped by treaty, the same protective aim moves into paperwork and technical rules.
senses.whyCN: 当关税被条约封顶，同样的保护目的就转入文书与技术规则。

senses.title: Protection of a single sector
senses.definition: protectionism applied to one industry, such as farming, steel or shipping
senses.definitionCN: 施加于某一行业（如农业、钢铁或航运）的保护主义
senses.example: Agricultural protectionism kept small farms alive but raised food prices.
senses.exampleCN: 农业保护主义让小块农场活了下来，却抬高了食品价格。
senses.why: Sector lobbies organize around one product, so the doctrine often appears with the industry's name attached.
senses.whyCN: 行业游说围绕单一产品组织起来，因此这种主张常附上行业名称。

senses.title: Protectionism as a political movement
senses.titleCN: 作为政治运动的保护主义
senses.definition: the organized political force that campaigns for barriers and against open trade
senses.definitionCN: 为壁垒奔走、反对开放贸易的有组织政治力量
senses.example: Protectionism gained seats in the election.
senses.exampleCN: 保护主义在选举中赢得了席位。
senses.why: A doctrine with supporters becomes a movement, and the word then names a camp rather than a measure.
senses.whyCN: 有支持者的主张会成为运动，于是这个词指一个阵营，而不是一项措施。

senses.title: New protectionism through technical rules
senses.titleCN: 借技术规则实现的新保护主义
senses.definition: the use of health, safety, environmental or technical standards as hidden barriers
senses.definitionCN: 把健康、安全、环境或技术标准当作隐蔽壁垒
senses.example: New protectionism hides inside product standards.
senses.exampleCN: 新保护主义藏在产品标准之中。
senses.why: Openly high tariffs invite retaliation, so protective intent disguises itself as legitimate regulation.
senses.whyCN: 公开的高关税会招致报复，因此保护意图伪装成正当监管。

senses.title: Protection in services and public contracts
senses.titleCN: 服务与公共采购领域的保护
senses.definition: the reservation of service markets or government contracts for domestic suppliers
senses.definitionCN: 把服务市场或政府采购留给本国供应商
senses.example: Protectionism in procurement shut foreign bidders out of the tender.
senses.exampleCN: 采购中的保护主义把外国投标者挡在招标之外。
senses.why: As goods barriers fall, the same shield moves to tenders, licences and professional qualifications.
senses.whyCN: 随着货物壁垒下降，同一面盾牌转向招标、许可与职业资格。

senses.title: The cost and retaliation of protection
senses.definition: the higher prices, retaliation and lost efficiency attributed to protective measures
senses.definitionCN: 归于保护措施的价格上升、报复与效率损失
senses.example: Economists warned that protectionism would invite counter-tariffs.
senses.exampleCN: 经济学家警告保护主义会招来反制关税。
senses.why: The word is usually used by critics, so it carries the claimed costs inside its meaning.
senses.whyCN: 这个词通常由批评者使用，因此它的词义里就带着所宣称的代价。

intro.en: Protectionism joins protection, from Latin protegere 'to cover in front', with -ism, a suffix for doctrines and systems. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: protectionism 把出自拉丁 protegere「在前面遮盖」的 protection，与表示主张与体系的后缀 -ism 组合起来。年代均为约数。

items.en: Tegere meant 'to cover', and it built words about roofs, clothing and concealment.
items.cn: tegere 意为「遮盖」，构成一批关于屋顶、衣物与掩蔽的词。

items.en: Pro- 'in front' plus tegere gave protegere 'to cover in front, defend', the source of protect.
items.cn: pro-「在前」加 tegere 构成 protegere「在前面遮盖、保卫」，是 protect 的来源。

items.en: English protection named the act of shielding, and by the eighteenth century also a policy of guarding trade.
items.cn: 英语 protection 指遮蔽的动作，到 18 世纪也指守护贸易的政策。

items.en: The suffix -ism came through French and Latin from Greek -ismos, and it names doctrines, systems and movements.
items.cn: 后缀 -ism 经法语与拉丁语来自希腊 -ismos，用来指学说、体系与运动。

items.en: Protectionism was coined in the free-trade debates of the nineteenth century as the label for the opposite camp.
items.cn: protectionism 在 19 世纪的自由贸易论战中被造出，用作对立阵营的标签。

note.en: The first group shares the covering root but has moved into other senses; the second group names policies and tools of the same family.
note.cn: 第一组共享「遮盖」词根但语义已转移；第二组是同一族系的政策与工具。

entries.definition: The act or state of being shielded; it can describe a helmet or a law, with no political camp attached.
entries.definitionCN: 被遮蔽的动作或状态；它可以描述头盔或法律，不带政治阵营色彩。

entries.definition: Serving to shield; it describes a quality or a measure, not a systematic policy.
entries.definitionCN: 起遮蔽作用的；它描述性质或措施，不是一套系统政策。

entries.definition: One who defends another; the word names an agent, not an economic doctrine.
entries.definitionCN: 保护他人的人；这个词指施动者，不是经济主张。

entries.definition: A supporter of protectionism, or an adjective describing such policies; the -ist form names the person, the -ism form names the doctrine.
entries.definitionCN: 保护主义的支持者，或描述这类政策的形容词；-ist 形式指人，-ism 形式指主张。

entries.definition: A duty on imports; it is the tool most often used by protectionism, but a single tariff is not a whole doctrine.
entries.definitionCN: 对进口征收的税；它是保护主义最常用的工具，但单项关税不是整套主张。

entries.definition: Any measure that obstructs imports or exports; protectionism is the policy of erecting such barriers.
entries.definitionCN: 任何阻碍进出口的措施；保护主义就是立起这类壁垒的政策。

entries.definition: The older doctrine that a state should maximize exports and treasure bullion; protectionism is its modern, narrower descendant.
entries.definitionCN: 较早的学说，主张国家应尽量扩大出口并珍视金银；保护主义是其现代、较窄的后裔。

entries.definition: A policy of staying out of foreign entanglements; it concerns diplomacy and war, not only trade.
entries.definitionCN: 避免卷入对外纠葛的政策；它关乎外交与战争，不只是贸易。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real covering root, the real doctrine suffix and real policy phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的「遮盖」词根、真实的主张后缀与真实政策搭配。

normal.en: Protect is to cover in front; -ism makes it a doctrine, so the word is a policy of standing a shield before home industry.
normal.cn: protect 是在前面遮盖；-ism 使之成为主张，因此这个词就是把盾牌挡在本国产业前的政策。

normal.en: The family runs protect, protection, protective, protector and protectionist.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 protect、protection、protective、protector 与 protectionist。

normal.en: Fixed phrases show the uses: trade protectionism, rising protectionism, a wave of protectionism.
normal.cn: 固定搭配显示用法：贸易保护主义、抬头的保护主义、保护主义浪潮。

normal.en: The standard opposite is free trade, and the two are usually defined against each other.
normal.cn: 标准反义说法是自由贸易，两者通常互为定义。

normal.en: The word is mostly used by critics, so it carries an implied judgment.
normal.cn: 这个词多由批评者使用，因此带有隐含的评判。

abstract.en: Picture a wall built around a factory while ships wait outside with their cargo unloaded.
abstract.cn: 想象一道墙把工厂围住，船在墙外等待，货物无法卸下。

abstract.en: Picture a tariff schedule posted like a menu at a border window.
abstract.cn: 想象一份关税表像菜单一样贴在边境窗口。

abstract.en: Picture a rulebook of standards so thick that only local producers know how to pass it.
abstract.cn: 想象一本标准规则书厚到只有本地生产者知道怎么通过。

examples.en: Rising protectionism slowed the growth of world trade.
examples.cn: 保护主义抬头使世界贸易增长放缓。

examples.en: The report blamed protectionism for higher consumer prices.
examples.cn: 报告把消费价格上涨归咎于保护主义。

examples.en: Small economies suffer most when protectionism spreads.
examples.cn: 保护主义蔓延时，小经济体受损最重。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「给本国产业加一道护墙」——protect 是保护，加上主义，就是用关税与规则筑墙 → 保护主义

root: protect 出自拉丁 protegere「在前面遮盖」= pro-（在前）+ tegere「遮盖」；-ism 经法语与拉丁语来自希腊 -ismos，指学说与体系。合指庇护本国产业、限制外国竞争的政策主张。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all describe one shield in different forms: the general policy, tariffs, non-tariff rules, a single sector, a political movement, disguised technical rules, services and procurement, and finally the costs critics attach to it.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项描述同一面盾牌的不同形态：总体政策、关税、非关税规则、单一行业、政治运动、伪装的技术规则、服务与采购，最后是批评者所附的代价。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wall around home factories while foreign cargo waits outside.
core.cn: 核心意象：本国工厂外筑起高墙，外国货物在墙外等待。

branches.en: BASE SHIELD: a covering is placed before domestic producers.
branches.cn: 基础盾牌：在本国生产者之前放上一层遮蔽。

branches.en: PRICE WALL: duties make foreign goods dearer.
branches.cn: 价格之墙：关税使外国货更贵。

branches.en: PAPER WALL: quotas, licences and standards do the same work quietly.
branches.cn: 纸面之墙：配额、许可与标准悄悄做同样的事。

branches.en: ORGANIZED INTEREST: a sector or a movement campaigns for the shield.
branches.cn: 有组织的利益：某个行业或一场运动为这面盾牌奔走。

branches.en: EXPANDED AND COSTED: the shield reaches services and tenders, and carries a bill.
branches.cn: 扩展与代价：盾牌伸到服务与招标，并附带一张账单。

intro.en: Protectionism is a Latin verb of covering turned into a doctrine by a Greek-derived suffix.
intro.cn: protectionism 是一个拉丁表示遮盖的动词，被一个希腊来源的后缀变成一种主张。

latinIntro.en: Latin tegere 'to cover' gives protect, protection, protective, protector and detect; Greek -ismos gives the suffix -ism.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 tegere「遮盖」衍生 protect、protection、protective、protector 与 detect；希腊 -ismos 提供后缀 -ism。

items.example: The prefix places the covering ahead.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把遮蔽物放在前面。

items.example: The root builds words of covering.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根构成一批表示遮盖的词。

items.example: Tariffs protect domestic mills.
items.exampleCN: 关税保护本国工厂。

items.example: The industry asked for protection.
items.exampleCN: 该行业请求保护。

items.example: Protective duties were imposed.
items.exampleCN: 保护性关税被征收。

items.example: A protector of local jobs spoke.
items.exampleCN: 一位本地就业的保护者发了言。

items.example: The suffix names political camps.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀为政治阵营命名。

items.example: Protectionism raised the price of steel.
items.exampleCN: 保护主义抬高了钢价。

items.example: Protectionists blocked the treaty.
items.exampleCN: 保护主义者阻挠了该条约。

items.example: The sensor detects movement.
items.exampleCN: 传感器察觉移动。

definition_zh: 甲烷；最简单的烷烃，一个碳原子与四个氢原子结合的气体
definition_en: the simplest hydrocarbon, a colourless gas of one carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms
core_image: 燃气灶上稳定的蓝色火焰，灶台旁放着一只检测管
scene: 厨房里，燃气灶的蓝色火焰稳定地燃烧，工程师蹲下检查管道接口。 The blue flame on the stove is methane burning with plenty of oxygen.
sceneCN: 这里指作为燃气主要成分的甲烷（第 2 个义项：天然气的主体成分）；句意为灶上的蓝色火焰就是甲烷在氧气充足时燃烧。图中可辨识物件：燃气灶、蓝色火焰、管道接口、检测管。

pos.zh: 名词：不可数，指这种气体或其在混合物中的成分

derivatives.zh: 由本词词干加表示「基团」的成分构成，义为「甲基」
由「甲基」加表示「醇」的成分构成，义为「甲醇」
本词与表示「水合物」的词构成的复合术语，义为「甲烷水合物」
由本词加表示「产生者」的成分构成，义为「产甲烷菌」
由本词加表示「生成」的成分构成，义为「产甲烷过程」
由本词加表示「以……为食」的成分构成，义为「食甲烷的」

senses.title: The chemical compound
senses.definition: the simplest alkane, a colourless and odourless gas with one carbon and four hydrogen atoms
senses.definitionCN: 最简单的烷烃，一个碳原子与四个氢原子结合的无色无味气体
senses.example: Methane is the simplest hydrocarbon, one carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms.
senses.exampleCN: 甲烷是最简单的烃，一个碳原子与四个氢原子相连。
senses.why: Chemistry needed a name for the first member of the alkane series, and every later member is built by adding carbon units.
senses.whyCN: 化学需要为烷烃系列的第一个成员命名，此后每个成员都以增加碳单位的方式构造。

senses.title: The main part of natural gas
senses.definition: the dominant component of the gas extracted from wells and burned for heat and power
senses.definitionCN: 从井中采出、用于取暖与发电的气体的主体成分
senses.example: Natural gas is mostly methane, with small amounts of heavier gases.
senses.exampleCN: 天然气主要是甲烷，另含少量较重的气体。
senses.why: The fuel people call gas is chemically almost one substance, which is why the two names are often used interchangeably.
senses.whyCN: 人们称作「燃气」的燃料在化学上几乎是单一物质，因此两个名称常被混用。

senses.title: Livestock and agricultural emissions
senses.definition: methane produced by ruminant digestion and by flooded rice fields
senses.definitionCN: 反刍动物消化与淹水稻田所产生的甲烷
senses.example: Cattle and rice paddies are large sources of methane.
senses.exampleCN: 牛群与稻田是甲烷的重要来源。
senses.why: Microbes in oxygen-free stomachs and mud make the gas, so agriculture becomes a chemical source.
senses.whyCN: 无氧的胃与泥中的微生物制造了这种气体，农业因此成为化学来源。

senses.title: Landfill gas and biogas
senses.definition: the gas released by decomposing waste or produced in a digester, often captured as fuel
senses.definitionCN: 垃圾分解释放或在消化器中产生、常被收集作燃料的气体
senses.example: Landfill methane can be captured and burned for power.
senses.exampleCN: 填埋场产生的甲烷可以被收集并燃烧发电。
senses.why: Waste buried without air is digested the same way a stomach digests, and the product can be put to use.
senses.whyCN: 无氧埋藏的垃圾像胃一样被消化，产物还可以被利用。

senses.title: A greenhouse gas
senses.definition: a gas that absorbs infrared radiation and warms the atmosphere, molecule for molecule far stronger than carbon dioxide over short spans
senses.definitionCN: 吸收红外辐射并使大气变暖的气体，短期内逐分子远强于二氧化碳
senses.example: Methane traps far more heat per molecule than carbon dioxide over a short period.
senses.exampleCN: 短期内甲烷每个分子截留的热量远多于二氧化碳。
senses.why: Its molecular bonds match infrared wavelengths, which is exactly what makes it a warming agent.
senses.whyCN: 它的分子键振动与红外波段相匹配，这正是它成为升温因素的原因。

senses.title: Methane hydrate
senses.definition: an ice-like solid in which methane sits inside cages of water molecules, found in deep sediments
senses.definitionCN: 甲烷被水分子笼状结构包裹的冰状固体，见于深海沉积层
senses.example: Methane hydrate is an ice-like solid found in deep sea sediments.
senses.exampleCN: 甲烷水合物是一种见于深海沉积层的冰状固体。
senses.why: Cold and pressure let water build cages around the gas, storing energy in a form that looks like ice.
senses.whyCN: 低温与高压让水在气体周围搭起笼子，把能量储存在看起来像冰的形态里。

senses.title: Methane in the carbon cycle
senses.definition: the short-lived but intense step in which carbon passes through a one-carbon gas before returning to carbon dioxide
senses.definitionCN: 碳以单碳气体形态经过的短暂而强烈的环节，随后返回二氧化碳
senses.example: Methane has a short lifetime in the air, but it is a potent warming agent.
senses.exampleCN: 甲烷在大气中的寿命很短，却是强效的升温因素。
senses.why: A gas that leaves the air quickly can still do damage quickly, so lifetime and potency must be read together.
senses.whyCN: 离开大气很快的气体也能很快造成影响，因此寿命与强度必须一起看。

senses.title: Methane on other worlds
senses.definition: the same molecule detected in the atmospheres and surfaces of other planets and moons
senses.definitionCN: 在其他行星与卫星的大气或表面探测到的同一分子
senses.example: Titan's atmosphere is rich in methane, giving it an orange haze.
senses.exampleCN: 土卫六的大气富含甲烷，因此呈现橙色雾霭。
senses.why: The molecule is common enough in the solar system that it becomes a marker of chemistry elsewhere.
senses.whyCN: 这种分子在太阳系中足够常见，因而成为其他地方化学活动的标记。

senses.title: Mine gas
senses.definition: the methane that accumulates in coal mines and must be drained or ventilated to prevent explosion
senses.definitionCN: 积聚在煤矿中、必须抽排或通风以防爆炸的甲烷
senses.example: Mine methane has to be ventilated before it can explode.
senses.exampleCN: 矿井甲烷必须先通风排出，否则就会爆炸。
senses.why: A gas that is harmless in a kitchen becomes a hazard when it collects in a confined working space.
senses.whyCN: 在厨房里无害的气体，一旦在封闭的工作空间聚集就成了危险。

intro.en: The name was coined in the nineteenth century from the Greek words for wine and wood, by way of the radical methyl. The coinage is documented; the exact year it was proposed is usually given as approximate.
intro.cn: 这个名称于十九世纪由表示「酒」与「木」的希腊词经「甲基」这一基团名构造而成。造词过程有据，提出的确切年份通常只给约数。

items.en: Methy meant wine, and the early chemists linked the radical to alcohol.
items.cn: 这个词表示酒，早期化学家因此把这个基团与酒精联系起来。

items.en: Hyle meant wood or matter, the second half of the older radical name.
items.cn: 这个词表示木或物质，是较早基团名的后半部分。

items.en: French chemists formed a name for the radical from those two Greek elements.
items.cn: 法国化学家由这两个希腊成分构造出该基团的名称。

items.en: The shorter radical name methyl then served as the base for the gas.
items.cn: 较短的基团名「甲基」随后成为这种气体的构词基础。

items.en: A suffix was chosen to mark hydrocarbons with only single bonds.
items.cn: 人们选定一个词尾来标记只含单键的烃。

items.en: Methyl plus that suffix gave methane, proposed in the eighteen sixties and quickly adopted.
items.cn: 「甲基」加上该词尾得到甲烷，于十九世纪六十年代提出并被迅速采用。

note.en: The first group shares the methyl stem or the alkane suffix; the second group names other gases of the same family or of the carbon cycle.
note.cn: 第一组共享「甲基」词干或烷烃词尾；第二组指同族或碳循环中的其他气体。

entries.definition: The chemical group of one carbon and three hydrogens.
entries.definitionCN: 一个碳与三个氢组成的化学基团。

entries.definition: The simplest alcohol, one carbon with an attached hydroxyl group.
entries.definitionCN: 最简单的醇，一个碳上连有羟基。

entries.definition: The older radical name from which methyl was shortened.
entries.definitionCN: 较早的基团名，甲基由其缩短而来。

entries.definition: The two-carbon member of the same alkane series.
entries.definitionCN: 同一烷烃系列中的二碳成员。

entries.definition: A microbe that produces methane.
entries.definitionCN: 产生甲烷的微生物。

entries.definition: The fuel mixture that is mostly methane.
entries.definitionCN: 以甲烷为主的燃料混合物。

entries.definition: Gas produced by decomposing organic matter.
entries.definitionCN: 有机物分解产生的气体。

entries.definition: The two-oxygen gas that methane becomes when it burns or breaks down.
entries.definitionCN: 甲烷燃烧或分解后生成的含两个氧的气体。

entries.definition: Any gas that traps heat in the atmosphere.
entries.definitionCN: 任何在大气中截留热量的气体。

entries.definition: An old name for methane bubbling out of wetlands.
entries.definitionCN: 对湿地冒出的甲烷的旧称。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations follow the gas from a single molecule to the stove, the farm, the landfill and the mine; abstract ones treat it as a short-lived but strong lever on the climate.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想沿着气体从单个分子到灶台、农场、填埋场与矿井展开；抽象联想把它看作对气候短暂却有力的杠杆。

normal.en: One carbon holding four hydrogens: that is the whole molecule.
normal.cn: 一个碳抱四个氢，整个分子就是这样。

normal.en: A kitchen flame is methane meeting enough oxygen.
normal.cn: 厨房的火焰就是甲烷遇到充足的氧气。

normal.en: Cows and flooded fields make it without any flame at all.
normal.cn: 牛与淹水的田地完全不靠火焰也能制造它。

normal.en: Buried waste releases it, and pipelines can collect it.
normal.cn: 埋藏的垃圾会释放它，管道可以把它收集起来。

normal.en: In a mine the same gas must be drained before it gathers.
normal.cn: 在矿井里，同样的气体必须在其聚集前被抽走。

abstract.en: Methane is a short-lived gas with a loud voice.
abstract.cn: 甲烷是一种寿命短、嗓门大的气体。

abstract.en: Because it leaves quickly, its damage is concentrated in time.
abstract.cn: 因为它离开得快，它的影响在时间上被集中。

abstract.en: A molecule that appears in kitchens, swamps and distant moons is the same molecule everywhere.
abstract.cn: 出现在厨房、沼泽与遥远卫星上的分子，在任何地方都是同一个分子。

examples.en: The lab measured methane in air samples from the landfill.
examples.cn: 实验室测量了填埋场空气样本中的甲烷。

examples.en: Methane is a far more potent warming gas than carbon dioxide.
examples.cn: 甲烷是比二氧化碳强得多的升温气体。

examples.en: Drilling released methane that had been trapped in the sediment.
examples.cn: 钻探释放了原本封存在沉积物中的甲烷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「米散」——一个碳四个氢的气体散在空气里：甲烷

root: 由十九世纪化学命名体系构造：希腊语 methy「酒」与 hyle「木、物质」先构成基团名 methyl，再加表示单键烃的词尾构成 methane。「甲烷」这一中文名取「甲」为第一、首位的含义。造词过程清楚，确切提出年份为约数。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one molecule from the flask to the stove, the herd, the landfill, the atmosphere, the deep sea, other worlds and the mine.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟踪同一个分子，从烧瓶走到灶台、畜群、填埋场、大气、深海、其他天体与矿井。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steady blue flame on a stove.
core.cn: 核心意象：灶台上一簇稳定的蓝色火焰。

branches.en: THE CORE: one carbon with four hydrogens, and the fuel that is mostly this gas.
branches.cn: 核心：一个碳配四个氢，以及以它为绝对主体的燃料。

branches.en: THE PRODUCERS: animals and flooded fields, then buried waste and digesters.
branches.cn: 产生者：牲畜与淹水田地，然后是埋藏垃圾与消化器。

branches.en: THE CLIMATE ROLE: a strong absorber with a short stay in the air.
branches.cn: 气候角色：强吸收者，但在空气中停留短暂。

branches.en: THE DEEP STORE: gas held in icy cages under the sea floor.
branches.cn: 深海储存：被封在海底冰笼中的气体。

branches.en: THE ELSEWHERE AND THE DANGER: distant atmospheres and the confined space of a mine.
branches.cn: 他处与危险：遥远天体的大气，以及矿井的封闭空间。

intro.en: Two Greek nouns were fused into a chemical radical name, and a suffix for single bonds completed the gas.
intro.cn: 两个希腊名词被融合成一个化学基团名，再由一个表示单键的词尾完成这种气体的命名。

latinIntro.en: Greek supplies the words for wine and wood; the radical name came through French, and the gas name was coined in German and English chemistry. No Latin noun underlies the word, so the Latin entry list is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语提供了表示「酒」与「木」的词；基团名经法语传来，气体名则由德国与英国化学界构造。词背后没有拉丁名词，因此拉丁词条列表留空。

items.example: The first element tied the radical to alcohol.
items.exampleCN: 第一个成分把这个基团与酒精联系起来。

items.example: The second element named the material side of the radical.
items.exampleCN: 第二个成分命名该基团的物质一面。

items.example: It became the base of the gas name.
items.exampleCN: 它成为气体名称的基础。

items.example: It marked the older radical rather than the final gas.
items.exampleCN: 它标记较早的基团而非最终的气体。

items.example: It made clear that the gas has only single bonds.
items.exampleCN: 它明确表示这种气体只含单键。

items.example: The name marks the first member of the series.
items.exampleCN: 这个名称标记该系列的第一个成员。

items.example: The same stem with an alcohol ending.
items.exampleCN: 同一词干加上醇类词尾。

items.example: The stem plus a suffix for a producer.
items.exampleCN: 词干加上表示「产生者」的词尾。

derivatives.zh: 由本词词干加表示「基团」的成分构成，义为「甲基」
由「甲基」加表示「醇」的成分构成，义为「甲醇」
本词与表示「水合物」的词构成的复合术语，义为「甲烷水合物」
由本词加表示「产生者」的成分构成，义为「产甲烷菌」
由本词加表示「生成」的成分构成，义为「产甲烷过程」
由本词加表示「以……为食」的成分构成，义为「食甲烷的」

definition_zh: 摩擦；摩擦力；由摩擦产生的热与磨损；人与人之间的龃龉
definition_en: the resistance that arises when one surface moves against another, or the tension between people or groups
core_image: 两只手掌用力对着搓，掌纹之间冒出细碎的热与屑
scene: 两位同事为一份预算反复修改，会上说话越来越短。 Friction between the two colleagues slowed the project to a crawl.
sceneCN: 这里 friction 指人与人之间不断擦碰而产生的紧张（第 5 个义项：人际间的龃龉）；句意为两位同事之间的摩擦使项目慢得几乎停住。图中可辨识物件：摊开的预算表、两支笔、半杯冷掉的茶、关着的会议室门。

forms.label: 名词（摩擦音；由同一词根）

derivatives.zh: 摩擦的；由摩擦引起的
无摩擦的；顺畅无阻的
以摩擦的方式
摩擦音；摩擦音的（同一词根）

senses.title: The act of rubbing surfaces together
senses.titleCN: 两个表面相互擦过的动作
senses.definition: the act of two surfaces rubbing against each other while one or both move
senses.definitionCN: 一个或两个表面移动时相互擦过的动作
senses.example: The friction of the rope against the rail wore a groove in the wood.
senses.exampleCN: 绳子与栏杆的摩擦在木头上磨出一道沟。
senses.why: Latin fricare meant to rub, and its noun frictio named the rubbing itself before it named any force.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 fricare 意为「摩擦」，其名词 frictio 先指「擦」这个动作，之后才指一种力。

senses.title: The force that opposes sliding
senses.titleCN: 阻碍两表面相对滑动的力
senses.definition: the force produced when two surfaces in contact move against each other and resist the motion
senses.definitionCN: 两个接触面相互移动时产生并阻碍该运动的力
senses.example: Engineers added a low-friction coating to the piston.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师给活塞加了一层低摩擦涂层。
senses.why: Once the rubbing was studied as a quantity, the noun shifted from the action to the resistance it produces.
senses.whyCN: 当人们把这种擦动当作一个量来研究，名词就从动作转到它所产生的阻力。

senses.title: Heat and wear from rubbing
senses.definition: the heat or damage that rubbing produces on a surface or between parts
senses.definitionCN: 擦动在表面或部件之间产生的热或损伤
senses.example: The friction of the drill bit scorched the wood.
senses.exampleCN: 钻头摩擦把木头烫焦了。
senses.why: Rubbing two things together makes them warm and wears them down, so the word came to name the effects as well as the cause.
senses.whyCN: 两物相互擦会发热并损耗，于是这个词既指原因，也指结果。

senses.title: A rasping sound of rubbing
senses.definition: the harsh sound made when rough surfaces are drawn across each other
senses.definitionCN: 粗糙表面相互擦过时发出的刺耳声响
senses.example: The friction of the bow on the strings filled the hall.
senses.exampleCN: 弓在弦上的摩擦声充满了大厅。
senses.why: The ear hears the rubbing as noise, which is the same event described through another sense.
senses.whyCN: 耳朵把这种擦动听成声响，这仍是同一件事，只是换了一个感官来描述。

senses.title: Tension between people
senses.definition: a feeling of tension or annoyance between people who rub against each other's habits
senses.definitionCN: 人们因习惯相互擦碰而产生的紧张或恼怒
senses.example: Friction between the two colleagues slowed the project to a crawl.
senses.exampleCN: 两位同事之间的摩擦使项目慢得几乎停住。
senses.why: Two people who irritate each other are pictured as surfaces scraping, and the eighteenth-century figurative use made this sense common.
senses.whyCN: 相互惹恼的两个人被想象成两个相擦的表面，十八世纪以后的比喻用法使这一义流行起来。

senses.title: Disagreement that slows work
senses.titleCN: 使事情办不下去的意见不合
senses.definition: disagreement over plans or terms that makes cooperation difficult and slow
senses.definitionCN: 在计划或条件上的分歧，使合作变得困难而缓慢
senses.example: There was friction over who would pay for the repairs.
senses.exampleCN: 在由谁出修缮费的问题上出现了摩擦。
senses.why: When talks scrape instead of glide, the image moves from private annoyance to a dispute that blocks a joint task.
senses.whyCN: 当谈判不再是顺畅滑行而是相擦，画面就从私人的恼怒转到挡住共同事务的争执。

senses.title: Resistance inside a system
senses.titleCN: 系统或流程内部消耗的阻力
senses.definition: anything in a process, market or machine that makes movement slower or costlier
senses.definitionCN: 流程、市场或机器中使运转更慢或代价更高的一切因素
senses.example: The app was designed to remove friction from the checkout.
senses.exampleCN: 这款应用的设计目的是消除结账环节的阻力。
senses.why: Modern usage treats any drag in a flow as friction, borrowing the mechanical word for costs and delays.
senses.whyCN: 现代用法把流动中的任何拖拽都视为摩擦，用这个机械词来指成本与延误。

senses.title: Conflict between groups
senses.titleCN: 群体或阶层之间的冲突
senses.definition: repeated conflict or resentment between social groups that live or work in contact
senses.definitionCN: 接触密切的社会群体之间反复发生的冲突或怨气
senses.example: Friction between the two communities rose after the water shortage.
senses.exampleCN: 缺水之后，两个社群之间的摩擦加剧了。
senses.why: Communities that share a border rub against each other constantly, so the word widens from persons to whole groups.
senses.whyCN: 共享边界的社群不断相互擦碰，于是这个词从个人扩大到整个群体。

intro.en: Friction comes from Latin frictio 'a rubbing', from fricare 'to rub'; the deeper origin of fricare is uncertain, and the figurative sense for quarrels grew after the eighteenth century.
intro.cn: friction 来自拉丁 frictio「摩擦」，出自 fricare「摩擦、揉搓」；fricare 的更早来源不确定，指人际龃龉的比喻义是十八世纪以后长出来的。

items.en: Fricare meant to rub or chafe; its own earlier origin is uncertain, so no deeper root is claimed here.
items.cn: fricare 意为「摩擦、揉搓」；它更早的来源不确定，因此这里不声称更深的词根。

items.en: Frictio was the noun of that verb, naming a rubbing or the soreness left by it.
items.cn: frictio 是那个动词的名词，指一次摩擦或擦后留下的疼痛。

items.en: The word entered English through learned Latin and French, first as a term for rubbing and later for the resistance between surfaces.
items.cn: 这个词经学术拉丁语与法语进入英语，先指摩擦动作，后指表面之间的阻力。

items.en: Mechanics gave friction a measured place among forces, which fixed the physical sense of the word.
items.cn: 力学把摩擦列入可测量的力之中，固定了这个词的物理义。

items.en: Writers then applied the scraping image to quarrels and social life, producing the interpersonal sense.
items.cn: 随后作家把这种相擦的画面用到争吵与社交生活上，产生了人际义。

items.en: The first dates for the figurative senses are approximate; the mechanical sense is well recorded in the early modern period.
items.cn: 比喻义的最早年代为约数；机械义在近代早期已有明确记录。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like friction; the second group names neighbouring kinds of rubbing, drag and disagreement.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与 friction 相近；第二组是意思相邻的其他「摩擦、阻力、不和」说法。

entries.definition: A part of a whole or a number below one; it comes from Latin frangere 'to break', a different root, and only sounds like friction.
entries.definitionCN: 指整体的一部分或小于一的数；来自拉丁 frangere「打破」，与 friction 不同源，只是音近。

entries.definition: A break in bone or rock; from Latin frangere 'to break', with no link to rubbing.
entries.definitionCN: 指骨头或岩石的断裂；来自拉丁 frangere「打破」，与摩擦无关。

entries.definition: A consonant made by forcing air through a narrow gap; the name comes from the same verb for rubbing.
entries.definitionCN: 指气流挤过窄缝发出的辅音；名称出自同一个表示摩擦的动词。

entries.definition: The adjective of friction, used of forces, heat and unemployment that arise from rubbing or drag.
entries.definitionCN: friction 的形容词，用于由摩擦或阻力产生的力、热与失业。

entries.definition: Invented writing; it comes from Latin fingere 'to shape or feign', not from the verb for rubbing.
entries.definitionCN: 指虚构作品；来自拉丁 fingere「塑造、假装」，并非出自那个表示摩擦的动词。

entries.definition: Wear or a scraped wound caused by rubbing on a hard surface.
entries.definitionCN: 因与硬面摩擦造成的磨损或擦伤。

entries.definition: Any force or refusal that opposes motion; friction is one specific mechanical kind.
entries.definitionCN: 指阻碍运动的任何力或抗拒；摩擦是其中一种具体的机械类型。

entries.definition: The resistance of air or water to a moving object, or anything that slows progress.
entries.definitionCN: 指空气或水对运动物体的阻力，也指拖慢进展的事物。

entries.definition: Strain between people or groups that may break into conflict.
entries.definitionCN: 指人或群体之间可能爆发为冲突的紧张。

entries.definition: Open disagreement and a lack of harmony, stronger and more audible than friction.
entries.definitionCN: 指公开的分歧与不和谐，比 friction 更强、更外显。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin root, the real word family and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁词根、真实的同族词与真实的固定搭配。

normal.en: Fricare is Latin for to rub, so friction is rubbing before it is a force.
normal.cn: fricare 是拉丁语「摩擦」，所以 friction 首先是「擦」这个动作，然后才是一种力。

normal.en: The family runs frictional, frictionless, frictionally and the phonetic term fricative.
normal.cn: 同族词有 frictional、frictionless、frictionally 以及语音学术语 fricative。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the everyday sense: reduce friction, friction between, friction costs.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出日常义：减少摩擦、……之间的摩擦、摩擦成本。

normal.en: Physicists separate static friction, which holds a body still, from kinetic friction, which acts while it slides.
normal.cn: 物理学家把使物体停住的静摩擦与滑动时起作用的动摩擦区分开来。

normal.en: The deeper origin of fricare is uncertain, so no further root should be invented for it.
normal.cn: fricare 更早的来源不确定，不应为它编造更深的词根。

abstract.en: Picture two palms pressed together and rubbed hard until they feel warm.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手掌压在一起用力搓，直到发热。

abstract.en: Picture a stubborn drawer that screeches every time it is pulled.
abstract.cn: 想象一只倔强的抽屉，每次拉动都发出刺耳的响声。

abstract.en: Picture two people who agree on the plan but sigh at every sentence the other says.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人同意同一个计划，却对对方每句话都要叹一口气。

examples.en: Less friction in the bearing meant the motor ran cooler.
examples.cn: 轴承里的摩擦减少，意味着马达运转得更凉。

examples.en: The report blamed friction between agencies for the delayed response.
examples.cn: 报告把响应迟缓归咎于机构之间的摩擦。

examples.en: Repeated friction with the same neighbor can wear down a whole community.
examples.cn: 与同一邻居反复摩擦，会磨损整个社群。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「弗里克申」——两人一擦就生热，话不投机就起摩擦

root: 拉丁 fricare「摩擦、揉搓」→ 拉丁 frictio「摩擦」→ 英语 friction；fricare 更早的词源不确定，人际龃龉义是十八世纪后的比喻用法。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one scrape: surfaces rub, the rub turns into a force, into heat and wear, into noise, then into the scrape between people, between plans, inside a system and between whole groups.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一次擦碰：表面相互擦过，擦动变成一种力，又变成热与磨损、声响，随后变成人与人、计划与计划、系统内部以及群体之间的擦碰。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two palms pressed together and rubbed until they feel warm and gritty.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手掌压在一起用力搓，直到发热、发涩。

branches.en: THE SCRAPE ITSELF: before any force is named, the word simply describes two surfaces drawn across each other.
branches.cn: 擦本身：在指任何力之前，这个词只是描述两个表面相互擦过。

branches.en: THE FORCE MEASURED: the scrape becomes a quantity that engineers can reduce or use.
branches.cn: 被测量的力：擦动变成一个工程师可以减小或利用的量。

branches.en: WHAT THE SCRAPE LEAVES: warmth, wear and a harsh sound are the same event felt by skin and ear.
branches.cn: 擦动留下的东西：热、磨损与刺耳声，是同一件事被皮肤和耳朵感到的样子。

branches.en: BETWEEN PEOPLE AND PLANS: two habits scrape, and a shared task slows down.
branches.cn: 人与计划之间：两种习惯相擦，共同的任务就慢下来。

branches.en: SYSTEMS AND GROUPS: any drag in a flow, and any repeated conflict between communities, takes the same name.
branches.cn: 系统与群体：流动中的任何拖拽、社群间任何反复冲突，都用同一个名字。

intro.en: Friction is built from a Latin verb for rubbing and a noun ending, and the same verb supports several English words.
intro.cn: friction 由一个表示摩擦的拉丁动词和一个名词词尾构成，这个动词还支撑起若干英语词。

latinIntro.en: Latin fricare gives friction and the phonetic term fricative; the exact deeper source of fricare is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 fricare 衍生 friction（摩擦）与语音学术语 fricative（摩擦音）；fricare 更早的确切来源不确定。

items.example: The verb gives the whole picture of two surfaces in contact.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词给出两个表面相接触的完整画面。

items.structure: stem of fricare used before suffixes
items.example: The stem carries the action into the noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干把动作带进名词里。

items.example: The ending turns the verb of rubbing into a noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把表示摩擦的动词变成名词。

items.example: The Latin noun first names the act, not a force.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词先指动作，而不是一种力。

items.example: The English noun later takes on the measured mechanical sense.
items.exampleCN: 这个英语名词后来承担了可测量的机械义。

items.example: The adjective is used of forces, heat and unemployment.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词用于力、热与失业。

items.example: The suffix describes a surface or a process with no drag at all.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀描述完全没有阻力的表面或流程。

items.example: The adverb names the manner in which something is driven.
items.exampleCN: 这个副词说明某物被驱动的方式。

items.example: Phonetics borrows the rubbing image for air forced through a gap.
items.exampleCN: 语音学借用了这个摩擦画面，指气流被挤过窄缝。

definition_zh: 在文化方面；从文化角度；按某一群体的文化习惯；通过文化方式
definition_en: in relation to culture, or in a way that belongs to a particular culture
core_image: 两座隔着山脊的村庄各唱各的调子，旋律却在同一个拍点上合拢
scene: 两个村子隔着一道山脊，赶集时却唱着几乎相同的调子， The two neighbours are culturally close although their languages differ.
sceneCN: 这里 culturally 指「在文化层面上、从文化角度衡量」（第 1 个义项：就文化整体而言）；句意为这两个邻村虽然语言不同，文化上却很接近。图中可辨识物件：山脊、两村的路、集市摊位、相似的鼓点。

pos.zh: 在文化方面；从文化角度；按某一文化习惯地

derivatives.zh: 文化的；与文化有关的
文化；培养
有修养的；培养的
跨文化地；在不同文化之间
在社会文化层面上

senses.title: In cultural terms overall
senses.definition: in relation to culture as a whole way of life
senses.definitionCN: 就作为整套生活方式的文化而言
senses.example: The two neighbours are culturally close although their languages differ.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个邻村虽然语言不同，文化上却很接近。
senses.why: The adverb turns the adjective into a measuring rod: it says on which axis two things are being compared, and that axis is culture.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词把形容词变成一把量尺：它说明两件事物正沿哪条轴比较，而这条轴就是文化。

senses.title: As determined by culture
senses.definition: in a way that is shaped or caused by cultural beliefs and practices
senses.definitionCN: 以受文化信念与实践塑造或造成的方式
senses.example: What counts as polite is culturally determined, not natural.
senses.exampleCN: 什么算有礼貌是由文化决定的，而非天生如此。
senses.why: Here the adverb marks cause: the behaviour is not chosen freely but pressed into shape by the surrounding culture.
senses.whyCN: 这里的副词标记原因：这种行为并非自由选择，而是被周遭文化压成这个形状。

senses.title: In a way that fits a group's norms
senses.titleCN: 以符合某群体规范的方式
senses.definition: in a manner that is acceptable or suitable within a particular culture
senses.definitionCN: 以在某一文化中被接受或合适的方式
senses.example: The health workers were trained to give culturally appropriate advice.
senses.exampleCN: 这些卫生工作者受过训练，能给出符合当地文化习惯的建议。
senses.why: The same act can be respectful in one place and rude in another, so the adverb adds the test of local fitness.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动作在此处是尊重，在彼处却可能失礼，因此这个副词加上了「在当地是否合宜」的检验。

senses.title: By transmission through culture
senses.definition: by learning and social transmission rather than by genes
senses.definitionCN: 通过学习与社会传递，而非通过基因
senses.example: Song patterns are culturally transmitted from one generation to the next.
senses.exampleCN: 歌谣的样式是一代代通过文化传递的。
senses.why: The adverb can name the channel as well as the axis: what travels through teaching, imitation and memory travels culturally.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词既可指比较的轴，也可指传递的渠道：经由教导、模仿与记忆流传的东西，就是通过文化流传。

senses.title: In artistic and intellectual richness
senses.titleCN: 在艺术与智识丰富度方面
senses.definition: in terms of the arts, learning and intellectual life
senses.definitionCN: 就艺术、学问与智识生活而言
senses.example: The port is culturally rich, with theatres, presses and old libraries.
senses.exampleCN: 这座港口文化底蕴丰富，有剧院、出版社与古老图书馆。
senses.why: This narrows the axis from the whole way of life to its artistic products, the sense of culture as works and ideas.
senses.whyCN: 这把比较的轴从整套生活方式收窄到它的艺术产品，即 culture 作为作品与思想的窄义。

senses.title: With awareness of cultural difference
senses.definition: in a way that shows awareness of and respect for different cultural backgrounds
senses.definitionCN: 以表现出对不同文化背景的认识与尊重的方式
senses.example: The novel is culturally sensitive in its portraits of migrant families.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说在刻画移居家庭时对文化差异很敏感。
senses.why: The adverb here modifies the manner of an act: not just what is done, but how carefully the doer watches for cultural difference.
senses.whyCN: 这里的副词修饰做事的方式：不只是做了什么，还包括做事者多留意文化差异。

senses.title: Limited or bound by culture
senses.definition: in a way that is confined by the assumptions of one culture
senses.definitionCN: 以一种被某一文化的预设所局限的方式
senses.example: The early theory was culturally bound and ignored non-Western family forms.
senses.exampleCN: 早期理论受文化局限，忽视了非西方的家庭形态。
senses.why: The same axis can become a cage: what is culturally shaped may also be culturally limited, unable to see past its own assumptions.
senses.whyCN: 同一条轴也可能变成笼子：受文化塑造的东西，也可能受文化限制，看不见自身预设之外的事物。

senses.title: From a cultural viewpoint (discourse marker)
senses.titleCN: 从文化角度来说（话语标记）
senses.definition: used to introduce a judgement made from the standpoint of culture
senses.definitionCN: 用于引出从文化立场作出的判断
senses.example: Culturally speaking, the change matters more than the new road.
senses.exampleCN: 从文化角度来说，这一变化比那条新路更重要。
senses.why: Spoken English turns the adverb into a frame: it announces the angle from which the next claim should be heard.
senses.whyCN: 口语把这个副词变成框架：它宣告接下来那句话应从哪个角度去听。

intro.en: Culturally is the adverb of cultural, which is culture plus the Latin-derived adjective ending -al, with the English adverb ending -ly added on top. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: culturally 是 cultural 的副词，而 cultural 是 culture 加源自拉丁语的形容词词尾 -al，再叠上英语副词词尾 -ly。年代均为约数。

items.en: Latin cultura meant tilling and care, from colere, to till or worship; the noun reached English through French as culture.
items.cn: 拉丁语 cultura 意为耕作与照料，来自 colere「耕种、敬拜」；这个名词经法语进入英语，成为 culture。

items.en: The adjective ending -alis, of or belonging to, produced culturalis in later Latin and shaped English cultural.
items.cn: 形容词词尾 -alis 意为「属于……的」，在较晚的拉丁语中构成 culturalis，并塑造了英语 cultural。

items.en: Old English formed adverbs with -lice, originally a form of lic, body or form; the ending became Middle English -li and modern -ly.
items.cn: 古英语用 -lice 构成副词，它原本是 lic（身体、形体）的一种形式；这个词尾后来变成中古英语 -li 与现代英语 -ly。

items.en: English cultural plus -ly gave culturally, first in the sense of cultivation and later in the sense of shared life and the arts.
items.cn: 英语 cultural 加 -ly 得到 culturally，先指耕作，后指共有生活与艺术。

items.en: In the twentieth century the adverb spread through anthropology, education and policy, where culturally appropriate and culturally sensitive became fixed phrases.
items.cn: 二十世纪，这个副词经人类学、教育与政策领域扩散，culturally appropriate（文化上合宜）与 culturally sensitive（对文化差异敏感）成了固定搭配。

items.en: Source uncertain: the first English use of the adverb in the arts sense is not securely dated, and the pre-Latin origin of colere remains unsettled.
items.cn: 来源不确定：这个副词的艺术义在英语中的最早使用没有确切年代；colere 在拉丁语之前的来源亦无定论。

note.en: The first group holds forms of the same root that are easily swapped; the second holds adverbs that also frame a comparison but along another axis.
note.cn: 第一组是同根、极易误换的形式；第二组是同样引出比较、但换了比较轴的副词。

entries.definition: The adjective describing something as belonging to culture; culturally is the adverb that says in what respect.
entries.definitionCN: 描述某物属于文化的形容词；culturally 是说明「在哪个方面」的副词。

entries.definition: The noun for a way of life or the arts; it cannot stand where the adverb stands.
entries.definitionCN: 表示生活方式或艺术的名词；不能占据副词的位置。

entries.definition: An adjective for a refined person or for organisms grown in a medium; it evaluates a person, while culturally frames a comparison.
entries.definitionCN: 形容有修养的人或培养基中培育的生物；它评价人，而 culturally 引出比较。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to till land or develop a quality; the adverb never carries this action.
entries.definitionCN: 表示耕地或培养品质的动词；这个副词从不承担这一动作。

entries.definition: In terms of society and relations among people; culturally points to shared meanings and customs instead.
entries.definitionCN: 就社会与人与人之间的关系而言；culturally 则指向共有的意义与习俗。

entries.definition: In terms of ethnic origin or group membership; narrower than culturally, which also covers arts and policy.
entries.definitionCN: 就族裔来源或群体归属而言；比 culturally 窄，后者还包括艺术与政策。

entries.definition: In terms of art or artistic skill; it matches only the arts sense of culturally.
entries.definitionCN: 就艺术或艺术技巧而言；只与 culturally 的艺术义重合。

entries.definition: In the manner handed down over time; it stresses age and continuity, while culturally stresses shared meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 以随时间传下的方式；它强调年代与延续，而 culturally 强调共有意义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real adverb ending, the real family and the fixed phrases the word actually keeps.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的副词词尾、真实的同族词，以及这个词实际常用的固定搭配。

normal.en: cultural plus the adverb ending -ly: the same ending turns national into nationally and natural into naturally.
normal.cn: cultural 加副词词尾 -ly：同一词尾也把 national（民族的）变成 nationally（在全国范围内）、把 natural（自然的）变成 naturally（自然地）。

normal.en: The family runs culture, cultural, cultured, culturally, cross-culturally and socioculturally.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 culture（文化）、cultural（文化的）、cultured（有修养的）、culturally（文化上）、cross-culturally（跨文化地）、socioculturally（在社会文化层面上）。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the senses: culturally diverse, culturally appropriate, culturally sensitive, culturally bound.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各义项：文化上多元、文化上合宜、对文化差异敏感、受文化束缚。

normal.en: The adverb answers the question in what respect, not where or when.
normal.cn: 这个副词回答的是「在哪个方面」，而不是「在哪里」或「在何时」。

normal.en: Culturally speaking is the spoken frame that announces the angle of the next claim.
normal.cn: culturally speaking（从文化角度来说）是口语框架，用来宣告下一句话的角度。

abstract.en: Picture two villages on opposite slopes singing the same rhythm at the same moment.
abstract.cn: 想象两座山村位于相对的山坡，却在同一时刻唱出相同的节奏。

abstract.en: Picture a measuring stick laid not along distance but along shared habits.
abstract.cn: 想象一把量尺不是沿距离摆放，而是沿共同习惯摆放。

abstract.en: Picture a window that can be opened as a view or closed into a cage, depending on who holds it.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇窗，既可以打开成视野，也可以合拢成笼子，取决于谁握着它。

examples.en: The two regions are culturally linked by a common festival calendar.
examples.cn: 这两个地区因共有的节庆日历而在文化上相连。

examples.en: A joke that is funny at home may be culturally offensive abroad.
examples.cn: 在本地说来好笑的笑话，到了国外可能触犯文化禁忌。

examples.en: Culturally speaking, the new shopping street has changed very little.
examples.cn: 从文化角度来说，这条新商业街改变的东西其实很少。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「靠它扯」加「里」——靠共同习俗把彼此扯在一起，还落到具体的层面里，就是「在文化上」。

root: 由 cultural 加英语副词词尾 -ly 构成；cultural 来自拉丁语 cultura「耕作、照料」加形容词词尾 -alis。副词词尾 -ly 源自古英语 -lice。colere 在拉丁语之前的更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one question: on what axis, by what cause, in what manner and through what channel does culture shape a thing?
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一个问题展开：文化沿哪条轴、以什么原因、用什么方式、通过什么渠道塑造一件事物？

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ruler laid across two cultures to show where they meet and where they differ.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把横放在两种文化之间的尺子，标出它们在哪里相接、在哪里分开。

branches.en: AXIS AND FRAME: the plain comparison and the spoken frame both announce culture as the angle of judgement.
branches.cn: 比较轴与框架：平实的比较与口语框架都在宣告文化是判断的角度。

branches.en: CAUSE AND CHANNEL: culture both shapes behaviour and carries it from one generation to the next.
branches.cn: 原因与渠道：文化既塑造行为，也把行为一代代传下去。

branches.en: LOCAL FITNESS: what fits one group's norms may fail another's.
branches.cn: 当地合宜：符合某一群体规范的做法，换一个群体可能就不合适。

branches.en: ARTISTIC RICHNESS: the axis narrows from the whole way of life to its works and ideas.
branches.cn: 艺术丰富度：比较轴从整套生活方式收窄到它的作品与思想。

branches.en: AWARENESS AND LIMIT: culture can be watched with care or turned into a blind cage.
branches.cn: 意识与局限：文化可以被小心观照，也可能变成看不见的笼子。

intro.en: Culturally is a chain of three pieces: a Latin noun stem, a Latin adjective ending and an English adverb ending.
intro.cn: culturally 由三段串成：拉丁名词词干、拉丁形容词词尾与英语副词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin colere gives cultura, -alis makes it an adjective, and Old English -lice supplies the adverb ending that became modern -ly.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 colere 给出 cultura，-alis 把它变成形容词，古英语 -lice 提供后来变成现代 -ly 的副词词尾。

items.structure: colere (Latin verb, to till or worship)
items.example: The stem also builds cultivate and colony.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干也构成 cultivate（耕作、培养）与 colony（聚居地）。

items.example: The noun became English culture through French.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词经法语成为英语 culture。

items.example: The same ending builds natural and national.
items.exampleCN: 同一词尾也构成 natural（自然的）与 national（民族的）。

items.example: The museum is a cultural institution.
items.exampleCN: 博物馆是一个文化机构。

items.structure: -lice (Old English adverb ending, from lic, body or form)
items.example: The ending turns quick into quickly.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把 quick（快的）变成 quickly（快地）。

items.example: The two towns are culturally close.
items.exampleCN: 这两座镇在文化上很接近。

items.example: The team compared the results cross-culturally.
items.exampleCN: 团队对这些结果作了跨文化比较。

items.example: The practice is socioculturally specific.
items.exampleCN: 这一做法具有社会文化的特定性。

latinEntries.structure: colere, colui, cultum (Latin verb, third conjugation)
latinEntries.meaning: to till; to dwell; to worship

derivatives.meaning: in a way that spans cultures

definition_zh: 酶；催化生物化学反应、通常为蛋白质（少数为 RNA）的分子
definition_en: a molecule, usually a protein and sometimes an RNA, that speeds up a biochemical reaction without being consumed by it
core_image: 一把带凹槽的钥匙插进锁孔，锁一开，原本卡住的部件立刻分开，钥匙本身完好退出
scene: 这里指「酶」。 One enzyme in saliva begins breaking starch into sugars before the food has even been swallowed.
sceneCN: 这里 enzyme 指「酶」这一催化分子（第 1 个义项：催化生化反应而自身不被消耗的分子）；唾液中的酶在食物下咽前就开始把淀粉切成糖。图中可辨识物件：带凹槽的钥匙、锁孔、分开的部件、完好的钥匙。

derivatives.zh: 酶的；酶催化的
酶学
辅酶
酶原
酶联的

senses.title: The catalyst itself
senses.definition: a molecule that catalyses a biochemical reaction and is not consumed by it
senses.definitionCN: 催化生化反应而自身不被消耗的分子
senses.example: Each enzyme in the pathway is named for the reaction it runs.
senses.exampleCN: 通路中的每一种酶都按它催化的反应命名。
senses.why: Greek en- 'in' plus zymē 'leaven' produced a name for something inside yeast that drives change, and that name now labels the catalyst itself.
senses.whyCN: 希腊 en-「在内」加 zymē「酵素」造出一个名称，指酵母中驱动变化的东西，后来这个名称就指催化剂本身。

senses.title: Lowering the barrier
senses.titleCN: 催化作用：降低反应门槛
senses.definition: the catalytic act of lowering the activation energy so a reaction runs at body temperature
senses.definitionCN: 降低活化能、使反应能在体温下进行的作用
senses.example: Without the enzyme, the reaction would take hours instead of seconds.
senses.exampleCN: 没有这种酶，反应要数小时而不是数秒。
senses.why: the name originally marked what happens inside yeast, so the word also names the speeding up rather than the thing.
senses.whyCN: 这个名字最初标记酵母内部发生的事，因此它也能指「加快反应」这一动作，而非物体。

senses.title: One substrate, one reaction
senses.definition: the specificity of an enzyme for a particular substrate or a particular bond
senses.definitionCN: 酶只对特定底物或特定化学键起作用
senses.example: A protease will not touch a sugar, however similar the shape.
senses.exampleCN: 蛋白酶不会去碰糖，无论形状多相似。
senses.why: the active site is a shaped pocket, so specificity follows directly from the geometry of the catalyst.
senses.whyCN: 活性位点是一个有形状的口袋，因此专一性直接来自催化剂的几何形状。

senses.title: The shaped pocket
senses.titleCN: 活性位点：口袋与结合面
senses.definition: the region of the enzyme where the substrate binds and the reaction occurs
senses.definitionCN: 酶上与底物结合并发生反应的区域
senses.example: The active site holds the substrate in the one orientation that reacts.
senses.exampleCN: 活性位点把底物固定在唯一能反应的方向上。
senses.why: if the catalyst is a pocket, the pocket is the part that does the work, so the word extends to that region.
senses.whyCN: 如果催化剂是一个口袋，起作用的就是口袋本身，于是这个词也延伸到该区域。

senses.title: Rates and curves
senses.titleCN: 酶促动力学：速率与曲线
senses.definition: the quantitative study of how fast an enzyme works as substrate concentration rises
senses.definitionCN: 研究底物浓度升高时酶工作速率的定量描述
senses.example: The enzyme reaches half its maximum rate at a characteristic substrate level.
senses.exampleCN: 该酶在某一特征底物浓度下达到最大速率的一半。
senses.why: because enzymes are catalysts, measuring them means measuring rates, and the word carries that quantitative sense.
senses.whyCN: 由于酶是催化剂，研究它就是测速率，这个词也带上这种定量含义。

senses.title: Named with -ase
senses.titleCN: 命名与分类：以 -ase 结尾
senses.definition: an enzyme named by adding -ase to the substrate or the reaction, as in protease or dehydrogenase
senses.definitionCN: 在底物或反应名后加 -ase 构成的酶名，如蛋白酶、脱氢酶
senses.example: The ending -ase tells you at a glance that the word is an enzyme.
senses.exampleCN: -ase 结尾一眼就能看出这个词是酶。
senses.why: once the class had a naming rule, the suffix became part of what the word means.
senses.whyCN: 当这一类有了命名规则，后缀本身就成了词义的一部分。

senses.title: Blocked on purpose
senses.titleCN: 抑制与调控：被有意阻断
senses.definition: the enzyme as a target of inhibitors and of cellular regulation
senses.definitionCN: 酶作为抑制剂与细胞调控的靶点
senses.example: Statins inhibit the enzyme that makes cholesterol.
senses.exampleCN: 他汀类药物抑制制造胆固醇的酶。
senses.why: because a catalyst can be jammed, medicine and physiology read the word as something to switch off.
senses.whyCN: 由于催化剂可以被卡住，医学与生理学把这个词读成「可以关掉的东西」。

senses.title: Working outside a cell
senses.definition: an enzyme used as a tool in industry, food processing or therapy
senses.definitionCN: 在工业、食品加工或治疗中作为工具使用的酶
senses.example: Laundry detergents contain an enzyme that digests protein stains.
senses.exampleCN: 洗衣剂含有能分解蛋白污渍的酶。
senses.why: purified catalysts can be put to work outside the body, so the word also names a commercial and clinical tool.
senses.whyCN: 纯化后的催化剂可在体外工作，因此这个词也指一种商品与临床工具。

intro.en: Enzyme was coined in 1877 from Greek en- 'in' and zymē 'leaven, ferment'. It replaced the older word ferment for the agent rather than the process.
intro.cn: enzyme 于 1877 年由希腊 en-「在内」与 zymē「酵素、发酵剂」造出；它取代了较早的 ferment，用来指作用者而非过程。

items.en: zymē meant leaven or ferment, the stuff that makes dough rise and juice turn. The word is old in Greek and its deeper origin is not settled.
items.cn: zymē 指酵素或发酵剂，是让面团发起、果汁变味的东西。该词在希腊语中很古老，更深来源无定论。

items.en: Wilhelm Kühne proposed Enzyme in 1877 to name the agent responsible for fermentation, separating it from the process.
items.cn: Wilhelm Kühne 于 1877 年提出 Enzyme，用来命名负责发酵的作用者，把它与过程区分开。

items.en: Generally thought: the name means 'in yeast', because the fermenting agent was first studied in yeast extracts; Kühne's fuller argument is not documented in detail.
items.cn: 一般认为是：「在酵母中」之意，因为发酵作用者最早在酵母提取物中被研究；Kühne 更完整的论证并无详细记录。

items.en: English took enzyme in the late nineteenth century and dropped ferment for the agent; the first citation is approximate.
items.cn: 英语于 19 世纪后期吸收 enzyme，并用它取代 ferment 指作用者；最早书证年代为约数。

items.en: Twentieth-century biochemistry showed most enzymes are proteins and some are catalytic RNA, widening the definition.
items.cn: 20 世纪的生物化学表明多数酶是蛋白质，少数是催化性 RNA，从而拓宽了定义。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): zymē has no agreed pre-Greek origin, so any Indo-European form behind it is a reconstruction rather than a recorded word.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：zymē 在希腊语之前的来源并无共识，其背后的任何印欧形式都是重构，而不是有记录的实际词。

note.en: Group one holds words sharing the Greek zymē stem or the enzyme label but naming different things; group two holds the words of the reaction it runs.
note.cn: 第一组是共享希腊 zymē 词干或酶标签、但指不同事物的词；第二组是它所催化反应中的相关词。

entries.definition: The adjective 'of an enzyme'. It describes a reaction or a assay, never the catalyst as a countable object.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词「酶的」，描述反应或测定，不能作可数名词指催化剂本身。

entries.definition: A small molecule that assists an enzyme, such as NAD. It is not itself the protein catalyst.
entries.definitionCN: 指辅助酶的小分子，如 NAD；它本身不是蛋白催化剂。

entries.definition: An inactive form of an enzyme, built with -gen 'producing'. It must be cut before it works.
entries.definitionCN: 酶的失活前体，由 -gen「产生」构成；必须被切割后才能工作。

entries.definition: The study of enzymes, with -logy 'study'. It names a field of research.
entries.definitionCN: 研究酶的学科，由 -logy「学科」构成；指研究领域。

entries.definition: Any agent that speeds a reaction without being consumed; an enzyme is one kind of catalyst, and inorganic ones also exist.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指加快反应而自身不被消耗的作用者；酶是其中一类，也存在无机催化剂。

entries.definition: The molecule an enzyme works on. The enzyme is the tool; the substrate is the material.
entries.definitionCN: 指酶所作用的分子；酶是工具，底物是材料。

entries.definition: A non-protein substance, ion or small molecule, needed for activity. It assists rather than catalyses alone.
entries.definitionCN: 指活性所必需的非蛋白物质、离子或小分子；它辅助而非单独催化。

entries.definition: A protein-cutting enzyme, named with -ase. It is a member of the enzyme class, not the class itself.
entries.definitionCN: 指切割蛋白质的酶，由 -ase 构成；是酶类中的一员，而非该类整体。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: en- 'in' + zymē 'leaven': the leaven inside the cell.
normal.cn: en-「在内」+ zymē「酵素」：细胞里的那点「酵」。

normal.en: The family runs enzyme, enzymatic, enzymic, enzymology, coenzyme, zymogen.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 enzyme、enzymatic、enzymic、enzymology、coenzyme、zymogen。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: digestive enzyme, enzyme activity, enzyme inhibitor, immobilized enzyme.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：消化酶、酶活性、酶抑制剂、固定化酶。

normal.en: Class naming rule: substrate or reaction plus -ase, as in protease and dehydrogenase.
normal.cn: 类别命名规则：底物或反应加 -ase，如蛋白酶、脱氢酶。

normal.en: An enzyme is a key, the substrate is the lock, and the reaction is the door opening.
normal.cn: 酶是钥匙，底物是锁，反应是门被打开。

abstract.en: Picture a key that leaves the lock exactly as it found it, ready for the next turn.
abstract.cn: 想象一把钥匙开完锁后原样退出，等待下一次转动。

abstract.en: Picture a workbench whose dent fits one part and no other.
abstract.cn: 想象一张工作台，其凹槽只容得下一种零件。

abstract.en: Picture a factory that can be shut down by jamming a single station.
abstract.cn: 想象一座工厂，卡住一个工位就能让它停工。

examples.en: The enzyme is reusable, so a small amount handles a large batch.
examples.cn: 这种酶可重复使用，少量即可处理一大批。

examples.en: Heat denatures the enzyme and the reaction stops.
examples.cn: 高温使酶变性，反应随之中止。

examples.en: Restriction enzymes cut DNA at specific sequences.
examples.cn: 限制性内切酶在特定序列处切割 DNA。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「按（en）在酵（zyme）里」——细胞里那点让反应跑起来的「酵」 → 酶

root: 希腊 en-「在内」+ zymē「酵素、发酵剂」→ 德语 Enzyme（1877，Kühne 提议）→ 英语 enzyme。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one movement: a shaped key enters a lock, turns, leaves unchanged, and the door opens; that movement is then read as the agent, the speeding up, the fit, the pocket, the rate, the naming rule, the jammed lock, and the tool sold outside.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：一把有形状的钥匙进锁、转动、原样退出，门随之打开；这一动作依次被读成作用者、加速、契合、口袋、速率、命名规则、被卡住的锁，以及卖到体外的工具。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shaped key entering a lock, turning, and leaving exactly as it came.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把有形状的钥匙进锁、转动，原样退出。

branches.en: THE AGENT: the key itself, named for what happens inside yeast.
branches.cn: 作用者：钥匙本身，因酵母内部发生的事而得名。

branches.en: THE TURN: catalysis, the barrier lowered so the door opens.
branches.cn: 转动：催化，门槛降低使门打开。

branches.en: THE FIT: specificity and the pocket that makes it.
branches.cn: 契合：专一性，以及造成专一性的口袋。

branches.en: MEASURE AND NAME: rates and curves, and the -ase rule that labels the class.
branches.cn: 测量与命名：速率与曲线，以及标记该类的 -ase 规则。

branches.en: JAM AND EXPORT: a target to block, and a purified tool put to work outside the cell.
branches.cn: 卡住与外用：可被阻断的靶点，以及纯化后在胞外工作的工具。

intro.en: Enzyme is a Greek compound of a preposition and a noun; the English family adds Latin -aticus and Greek -logia as well as the modern -ase.
intro.cn: enzyme 是希腊介词与名词的合成词；英语词族另加拉丁 -aticus、希腊 -logia 以及现代的 -ase。

latinIntro.en: There is no classical Latin source. New Latin enzyma is a Latinized spelling, and -aticus is the Latin suffix that yields English -atic.
latinIntro.cn: 没有古典拉丁来源。新拉丁语 enzyma 是拉丁化拼写；-aticus 是产生英语 -atic 的拉丁后缀。

items.example: The enzyme remains active at thirty-seven degrees.
items.exampleCN: 该酶在三十七度下保持活性。

items.example: Salivary enzymes start digesting starch.
items.exampleCN: 唾液中的酶开始消化淀粉。

items.meaning: of an enzyme; carried out by one
items.example: The reaction is enzymatic, not spontaneous.
items.exampleCN: 该反应是酶促的，不是自发的。

items.example: Enzymic hydrolysis released the sugar.
items.exampleCN: 酶解作用释放了糖。

items.example: Enzymology grew out of fermentation research.
items.exampleCN: 酶学从发酵研究中成长起来。

items.example: NAD acts as a coenzyme in oxidation.
items.exampleCN: NAD 在氧化中作辅酶。

items.example: Trypsinogen is a zymogen of trypsin.
items.exampleCN: 胰蛋白酶原是一种酶原。

items.example: A protease removes the signal peptide.
items.exampleCN: 蛋白酶切去信号肽。

items.example: Dehydrogenase feeds electrons into the chain.
items.exampleCN: 脱氢酶把电子送入传递链。

items.meaning: attached to an enzyme for detection
items.example: An enzyme-linked assay measured the hormone.
items.exampleCN: 一种酶联测定法测量了该激素。

latinEntries.meaning: relating to, of the nature of

definition_zh: 树冠层；顶篷；带顶罩的床；降落伞伞衣
definition_en: the upper layer of trees in a forest; a roof-like covering, as over a bed, a procession, an aircraft cockpit or a parachute
core_image: 一片森林顶部连成一张起伏的绿顶，把下面的地面遮成半阴
scene: 雨林里抬头几乎看不见天空，层层树冠把阳光筛成细碎的光斑。 In the rainforest you can barely see the sky, because the layered canopy filters the sunlight into small bright patches.
sceneCN: 这里该词指「森林上层的树冠层」（第 1 个义项：林木顶部连成的覆盖层）；句意为在雨林里几乎看不见天空，因为层层树冠把阳光筛成小块光斑。

pos.zh: 比喻义：覆盖在头顶的一层（如星空）

forms.label: 复数（多片林冠；多个顶篷）

derivatives.zh: 有顶篷的；被树冠覆盖的
加顶篷；形成覆盖（少用）
无顶篷的（少用）
树冠（单株树的枝叶整体）
遮阳篷

senses.title: Upper forest layer
senses.definition: the upper layer of a forest formed by the crowns of the tallest trees
senses.definitionCN: 由最高树木的树冠形成的森林上层
senses.example: The canopy closes over the trail in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 夏天，林冠在小径上方合拢。
senses.why: This is the ecological sense: many crowns together form one continuous roof.
senses.whyCN: 这是生态义：许多树冠共同形成一整片连续的顶。

senses.title: Roof-like covering
senses.definition: a roof-like structure that provides shade or shelter
senses.definitionCN: 提供遮阴或遮蔽的顶状结构
senses.example: A striped canopy shaded the café tables.
senses.exampleCN: 一条条纹顶篷为咖啡座的桌子遮阴。
senses.why: The word generalizes from trees to any man-made roof that spreads overhead.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从树木扩展到任何在头顶铺开的人造顶。

senses.title: Canopy bed
senses.definition: a bed with a frame and a hanging cover over it
senses.definitionCN: 上方有框架和悬挂顶罩的床
senses.example: The guest room has an old wooden canopy bed.
senses.exampleCN: 客房有一张旧木制顶罩床。
senses.why: The bed keeps the old sense of a hanging cloth spread over a resting place.
senses.whyCN: 这种床保留了旧义：一块悬挂的布铺在休息处上方。

senses.title: Parachute canopy
senses.definition: the fabric part of a parachute that fills with air and slows the fall
senses.definitionCN: 降落伞中充气并减速的织物部分
senses.example: The parachute canopy opened only seconds before landing.
senses.exampleCN: 降落伞伞衣在落地前几秒才打开。
senses.why: The fabric is a dome held overhead, so the tree-roof image fits exactly.
senses.whyCN: 织物是头顶撑起的穹顶，因此树冠顶篷的意象正好吻合。

senses.title: Aircraft canopy
senses.definition: the transparent cover over an aircraft cockpit
senses.definitionCN: 飞机座舱上方的透明罩
senses.example: The pilot released the canopy before ejecting.
senses.exampleCN: 飞行员在弹射前抛掉了座舱盖。
senses.why: A transparent shell over the pilot repeats the overhead-cover shape in hard material.
senses.whyCN: 飞行员上方的透明壳体，用硬质材料重复了头顶覆盖的形状。

senses.title: Ceremonial canopy
senses.definition: a decorated cloth carried over important people in a procession
senses.definitionCN: 仪式中在要人头顶撑起的装饰布篷
senses.example: Four attendants held the canopy above the bride.
senses.exampleCN: 四名侍从在新娘上方撑着华盖。
senses.why: A cloth held over a person marks rank, the same gesture as a roof held above.
senses.whyCN: 在人的上方撑布标记身份，与在头顶撑起顶盖是同一动作。

senses.title: Figurative overhead layer
senses.titleCN: 比喻义：头顶覆盖的一层
senses.definition: a layer that seems to spread overhead, such as the sky or a mass of stars
senses.definitionCN: 像在头顶铺开的一层，如天空或繁星
senses.example: A canopy of stars hung over the desert camp.
senses.exampleCN: 一片星空像华盖一样悬在沙漠营地之上。
senses.why: The physical roof becomes a visual metaphor for anything that covers the sky.
senses.whyCN: 实体的顶变成视觉比喻，指任何覆盖天空之物。

senses.title: Forestry canopy cover
senses.definition: the proportion of ground shaded by tree crowns, used as a measure of forest density
senses.definitionCN: 树冠遮蔽地面的比例，用作森林密度的量度
senses.example: Canopy cover reached eighty percent in the old-growth stand.
senses.exampleCN: 这片原始林的林冠覆盖度达到八成。
senses.why: The roof is now measured as a percentage, turning the image into a forestry variable.
senses.whyCN: 顶篷此时被量成百分比，意象变成林业变量。

intro.en: The word travelled from a mosquito net to a bed cover, then to any roof-like cover, and finally to forest layers. The Greek base is clear but its deeper origin is disputed.
intro.cn: 希腊语基础词清楚，但其更深来源不确定；中世纪拉丁语与法语的传递环节较清楚，各专业义出现年代为大致估计。

items.en: The source is kōnōpeion 'mosquito net', built from kōnōps 'gnat, mosquito'. The further origin of kōnōps is uncertain; a link to kōnos 'cone' has been suggested but not established.
items.cn: 来源是希腊语 kōnōpeion「蚊帐」，由 kōnōps「蚊、蚋」构成。kōnōps 的更深来源不确定；有人提出与 kōnos「圆锥」有关，但未获确证。

items.en: Latin conopeum kept the meaning 'mosquito net, bed curtain'. The medial -p- and the later spelling with -a- reflect transmission through Medieval Latin.
items.cn: 拉丁语 conopeum 保留「蚊帐、床帘」的意思。中间的 -p- 与后来带 -a- 的拼写反映了中世纪拉丁语的传递。

items.en: Medieval Latin canopeum, perhaps influenced by canopeum 'canopy', passed into Old French as conopé and then into English.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 canopeum（可能受 canopeum「华盖」影响）传入古法语作 conopé，再进入英语。

items.en: Early English canopy meant a hanging cloth over a bed or a throne. The covering sense then extended to processions and doorways.
items.cn: 早期英语 canopy 指床或宝座上方的悬挂布。覆盖义随后扩展到游行与门廊。

items.en: The word was applied to any roof-like shelter, and in the nineteenth century to the fabric dome of a parachute.
items.cn: 这个词被用于任何顶状遮蔽物，十九世纪又用于降落伞的织物穹顶。

items.en: Ecology adopted canopy for the upper forest layer, aviation for the cockpit cover, and forestry for a measurable canopy cover.
items.cn: 生态学采用 canopy 指森林上层，航空用指座舱盖，林业则用指可测量的林冠覆盖度。

note.en: The first group is close in sound or spelling but unrelated; the second group shares the idea of an overhead cover or a tree top.
note.cn: 第一组在读音或拼写上接近但无关；第二组共享「头顶覆盖物」或「树顶」的意思。

entries.definition: a small piece of food served on bread or a cracker, from French canapé 'sofa'; it is unrelated to canopy.
entries.definitionCN: 夹心小点。来自法语 canapé「沙发」，与 canopy 无关。

entries.definition: a factory where food is canned; it comes from can, not from canopy.
entries.definitionCN: 罐头厂。来自 can「罐头」，不是 canopy。

entries.definition: a disaster, from Latin calamitas; the similarity is only in the ending.
entries.definitionCN: 灾难。来自拉丁语 calamitas，相似只在线性结尾。

entries.definition: the branches and leaves of one tree; many crowns together make a canopy, but one crown is not the whole layer.
entries.definitionCN: 树冠。单株树的枝叶；许多树冠合成林冠，但单株树冠不等于整层。

entries.definition: a sheet of canvas fixed over a door or window to give shade; it is a smaller, fixed cover, not a spreading roof.
entries.definitionCN: 遮阳篷。固定在门窗上方遮阴的帆布，是较小固定的覆盖，不是铺开的顶。

entries.definition: the upper surface of a room; it is an interior boundary, while a canopy is an overhead cover in open air.
entries.definitionCN: 天花板。房间的上表面，是室内边界；canopy 是露天头顶的覆盖。

entries.definition: the shadow or coolness produced by a cover; it names the effect, not the structure.
entries.definitionCN: 阴凉；遮蔽。指覆盖产生的效果，而不是结构本身。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The Greek source meant 'mosquito net', which is already a covering held overhead.
normal.cn: 希腊来源词意为「蚊帐」，本身就是头顶的覆盖物。

normal.en: The word passed through Latin and French before entering English.
normal.cn: 这个词经拉丁语与法语进入英语。

normal.en: Ecology collocations: forest canopy, canopy cover, canopy layer.
normal.cn: 生态搭配：森林林冠、林冠覆盖、林冠层。

normal.en: Aviation and sport collocations: cockpit canopy, parachute canopy.
normal.cn: 航空与运动搭配：座舱盖、降落伞伞衣。

normal.en: A canopy is many crowns together; a crown is one tree's top.
normal.cn: canopy 是许多树冠合成的一层；crown 是单株树的顶部。

abstract.en: Picture a green ceiling made of leaves, with small holes for sunlight.
abstract.cn: 想象一片叶子做成的绿色天花板，上面有小孔漏下阳光。

abstract.en: Picture a cloth held over a bride by four attendants walking in step.
abstract.cn: 想象四名侍从同步行走，把一块布撑在新娘头顶。

abstract.en: Picture a parachute as a soft roof that catches the air.
abstract.cn: 想象降落伞是一顶接住空气的软屋顶。

examples.en: Logging opened the canopy and let dry wind reach the forest floor.
examples.cn: 采伐打开了林冠，让干燥的风吹到林地表面。

examples.en: The market stalls were covered by a blue canvas canopy.
examples.cn: 市场摊位上方盖着蓝色帆布顶篷。

examples.en: Canopy cover is used as an index of how dense the forest is.
examples.cn: 林冠覆盖度被用作衡量森林密度的指标。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「盖你披」——盖在头顶、披在上方的一层 → 顶篷、林冠

root: 希腊语 kōnōpeion「蚊帐」，由 kōnōps「蚊、蚋」构成；经拉丁语 conopeum 与中世纪拉丁语、法语进入英语。kōnōps 的更深来源不确定，与 kōnos「圆锥」的联系仅为假说。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all describe something spread overhead. The ecological layer is made of crowns; the bed, café, procession, aircraft and parachute covers are fabrics or shells; the starry canopy is a visual metaphor; canopy cover turns the roof into a number.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都描述在头顶铺开的东西。生态层由树冠组成；床、咖啡座、游行、飞机与降落伞的覆盖是织物或壳体；星空华盖是视觉比喻；林冠覆盖度则把顶篷变成数字。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a spread layer held above what it protects.
core.cn: 核心意象：一层在上方铺开、遮蔽其下之物的覆盖。

branches.en: FOREST ROOF: many crowns form a layer, and that layer can be measured.
branches.cn: 森林顶：许多树冠形成一层，这一层还能被测量。

branches.en: DOMESTIC COVER: café awning and bed canopy are cloth roofs.
branches.cn: 生活覆盖：咖啡座遮阳篷与床顶罩都是布制顶。

branches.en: SHELLS: parachute and cockpit canopy are hard or inflated domes.
branches.cn: 壳体：降落伞与座舱盖是硬质或充气穹顶。

branches.en: RITUAL COVER: a carried cloth marks honour.
branches.cn: 仪式覆盖：被撑起的布标记尊荣。

branches.en: METAPHOR: the sky becomes a canopy of stars.
branches.cn: 比喻：天空变成繁星华盖。

intro.en: Canopy is a borrowed word with a small English family; the affix section separates the Greek and Latin layers from later English compounds.
intro.cn: canopy 是借入词，英语词族较小；词缀部分把希腊、拉丁层次与后世英语复合词分开。

latinIntro.en: Greek kōnōpeion and Latin conopeum supply the base; Medieval Latin canopeum and French transmit it. English then built canopied and the compound canopy cover.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 kōnōpeion 与拉丁 conopeum 提供基础；中世纪拉丁语 canopeum 与法语传递；英语随后构造 canopied 与复合词 canopy cover。

latinEntries.structure: conopeum, conopei (n., second declension, Latin from Greek)

items.example: The canopy shades the path below.
items.exampleCN: 林冠给下方小径遮阴。

items.example: The two canopies meet above the street.
items.exampleCN: 两片顶篷在街道上方相接。

items.meaningCN: 有顶篷的；被林冠覆盖的
items.example: They walked along a canopied lane.
items.exampleCN: 他们走在有树冠覆盖的小路上。

items.meaning: the proportion of ground shaded by crowns
items.example: Canopy cover is measured from above.
items.exampleCN: 林冠覆盖度从上方测量。

items.example: Birds feed in the canopy layer.
items.exampleCN: 鸟类在林冠层取食。

items.meaning: a bed with an overhead frame and cover
items.example: The canopy bed has four carved posts.
items.exampleCN: 这张顶罩床有四根雕花柱。

items.meaning: the fabric dome of a parachute
items.example: The canopy caught the air at once.
items.exampleCN: 伞衣立刻兜住了空气。

items.meaning: the transparent cover of a cockpit
items.example: The cockpit canopy reflects the sun.
items.exampleCN: 座舱盖反射阳光。

items.meaning: the branches and leaves of one tree
items.example: The crown of the oak is wider than its root spread.
items.exampleCN: 这棵橡树的树冠比根系展幅更宽。

definition_zh: 方法；办法；条理；体系；（学科或艺术的）方法论体系
definition_en: a particular way of doing something, especially one that is planned and systematic, or the order and system that such a way produces
core_image: 一条被反复踩出的小路：草被踩平了，路指向远处的目标
scene: 老实验室里的那套流程几十年没有变过。 The lab still uses a method that has not changed in forty years.
sceneCN: 这里 method 是「方法」（第 1 个义项：做某事的特定程序）；句意：这个实验室仍在使用一套四十年没变过的方法。场景要点：一排贴着编号的旧仪器、墙上手写的步骤表、被踩得发亮的地面；对应第 1 个义项。

collocations.phrase: there is method in one's madness

derivatives.zh: 有条理的；按部就班的
有条理地；系统地
方法论；一套研究方法
方法论的；方法上的
方法论学者
使有条理；使系统化

senses.title: A way of doing something
senses.titleCN: 方法：做某事的特定路数
senses.definition: a particular procedure for doing something, especially a planned and systematic one
senses.definitionCN: 做某事的特定程序，尤指有计划、有系统的程序
senses.example: The lab still uses a method that has not changed in forty years.
senses.exampleCN: 这个实验室仍在使用一套四十年没变过的方法。
senses.why: Method reached English in the early 15th century from Greek methodos, originally 'pursuit, a following after'. A method is a path that has already been walked and can be walked again.
senses.whyCN: method 于 15 世纪初从希腊语 methodos 进入英语，原义为“追寻、跟随其后”。方法就是一条已经被人走过、还可以再走一遍的路。

senses.title: Orderliness
senses.definition: the quality of acting in an orderly, systematic way rather than at random
senses.definitionCN: 做事有条理、有系统，而非随意的品质
senses.example: There was method in the way she sorted the files, though no one else could see it.
senses.exampleCN: 她整理文件的方式自有章法，只是别人看不出来。
senses.why: From the 1610s the word also named 'orderliness, regularity'. The path is no longer a particular route but the habit of always walking on one.
senses.whyCN: 自 17 世纪 10 年代起，这个词也指“有条理、有规律”。此时路不再是一条具体路线，而是“总要沿着某条路走”的习惯。

senses.title: A complete system
senses.definition: a complete set of rules or procedures for attaining an end
senses.definitionCN: 为达到某一目的而设的一整套规则或程序
senses.example: The school adopted a new method for teaching reading.
senses.exampleCN: 学校采用了一套新的阅读教学体系。
senses.why: The sense 'a system or complete set of rules' is recorded from the 1680s. Once a path is written down as rules, it can be taught to strangers.
senses.whyCN: “体系或完整规则集”这一义项自 17 世纪 80 年代有记录。一旦一条路被写成规则，它就能教给陌生人。

senses.title: Scientific method
senses.titleCN: 科学方法：学科自己的路
senses.definition: the established procedure of a discipline for testing claims and producing knowledge
senses.definitionCN: 某一学科为检验主张、生产知识而确立的程序
senses.example: The scientific method is less a single recipe than a set of habits of doubt.
senses.exampleCN: 科学方法与其说是一份单一配方，不如说是一组怀疑的习惯。
